messages:
elaine: Noticed increased warm-pool bootstrap failures in sa-1 starting ~08:05 UTC. Nodes can't reach keystore / audit collector during bootstrap.

omar: Any logs?

elaine: node-agent: 
```\n[2026-09-02T08:05:12Z] keystore: decrypt denied: IAM condition 'resource.tags.compliance==\"true\"' not met\n[2026-09-02T08:05:12Z] audit: POST https://audit-collector.internal/v1/ingest -> connection reset\n```\n\ninfra-bot: Alert: 37 nodes failing bootstrap in south-america-1 (>3m).

ben: Did security roll something out?

elaine: We pushed a stricter keystore IAM condition last night and a fw rule to drop malformed TLS handshakes. Seems node-agent handshake matched the drop signature and subnet tags missing -> KMS denied.

omar: Immediate plan: 1) temporarily widen keystore condition to allow infra-node-role in SA 2) add fw exception for node-agent cert CN 3) pause warm-pool scaling and restart stuck nodes. Who can take 1?

ben: I'll open a temp policy patch and the PR for scoped fix.

elaine: I'll add the fw exception and pause autoscaling for 20m. Command for pause: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name sa-warm-pool --max-size 60 --min-size 10 --region south-america-1`

infra-bot: Incident ticket SEC-3201 created.

omar: After applying fixes, ~70% of stuck nodes finished joining within 6 minutes. Remaining ones cleared after a small rolling restart. Costs spike estimated ~210 GPU-min (~$300).

ben: Postmortem actions: 1) require tag presence before policy deploys 2) add a handshake fingerprint exception test in CI for the collector 3) add an alert: keystore.decrypt.accept_rate < 99% within 30s. I'll own 1.

elaine: Agreed. Leaving SEC-3201 open for RCA and runbook updates. Thanks. :thumbsup:
